description: Contains player-specific data over the whole game for the web app.

avatar_id.description: The avatar ID for this player.

court_coverage.description: Categorizes stats about a players court coverage across all rallies.
court_coverage.title: Court Coverage

kitchen_arrival_percentage.description: Counts of fair kitchen-arrival opportunities (denominator) and successful arrivals (numerator), broken down by serving/returning roles for the player and their partner.

denominator.description: Number of rallies where the player had a fair opportunity to arrive within a few feet of the kitchen when on the returning team, as the returner (requires at least 3 non-fault shots).
denominator.title: Count

numerator.description: Number of rallies where the player successfully arrived within a few feet of the kitchen when on the returning team, as the returner (requires at least 3 non-fault shots).
numerator.title: Count

denominator.description: Number of rallies where the player had a fair opportunity to arrive within a few feet of the kitchen when on the returning team, as the partner of the returner (requires at least 3 non-fault shots).
denominator.title: Count

numerator.description: Number of rallies where the player successfully arrived within a few feet of the kitchen when on the returning team, as the partner of the returner (requires at least 3 non-fault shots).
numerator.title: Count

denominator.description: Number of rallies where the player had a fair opportunity to arrive within a few feet of the kitchen when on the serving team, as the server (requires at least 4 non-fault shots).
denominator.title: Count

numerator.description: Number of rallies where the player successfully arrived within a few feet of the kitchen when on the serving team, as the server (requires at least 4 non-fault shots).
numerator.title: Count

denominator.description: Number of rallies where the player had a fair opportunity to arrive within a few feet of the kitchen when on the serving team, as the partner of the server (requires at least 4 non-fault shots).
denominator.title: Count

numerator.description: Number of rallies where the player successfully arrived within a few feet of the kitchen when on the serving team, as the partner of the server (requires at least 4 non-fault shots).
numerator.title: Count

kitchen_arrival_percentage.title: Kitchen Arrival Opportunity Stats

left_side_percentage.description: The percentage of time when this player was to the left of their partner.
left_side_percentage.title: Percentage

positional_performance.description: Team-level positional performance metrics derived from the advantage-scale model. Omitted for singles or when too few supported rallies are available.

finishing_ability.description: Team-level Close in [0, 1]: how efficiently the player's team converted positional advantage into ending the rally, independent of rally outcomes. Both teammates share the same value; team 1's value is the complement of team 0's.

forward_pressure.description: Team-level Push in [0, 1]: how actively the player's team drove each shot toward their positional advantage, independent of rally outcomes. Both teammates share the same value; team 1's value is the complement of team 0's.

role_data.description: data about this player in each serving and receiving role
role_data.title: Role Data

shot_count.description: The total number of shots by the player.
shot_count.title: Count

team.description: The team to which the player belongs.

team_kitchen_arrival.description: Counts of rallies where both teammates had a fair opportunity to arrive at the kitchen (denominator) and both successfully arrived (numerator), broken down by serving/returning roles. Both players on the same team share identical values.

denominator.description: Number of rallies where both teammates had a fair opportunity to arrive at the kitchen when on the returning team (requires at least 3 non-fault shots).
denominator.title: Count

numerator.description: Number of rallies where both teammates arrived at the kitchen when on the returning team (requires at least 3 non-fault shots and both players having a fair opportunity).
numerator.title: Count

denominator.description: Number of rallies where both teammates had a fair opportunity to arrive at the kitchen when on the serving team (requires at least 4 non-fault shots).
denominator.title: Count

numerator.description: Number of rallies where both teammates arrived at the kitchen when on the serving team (requires at least 4 non-fault shots and both players having a fair opportunity).
numerator.title: Count

team_kitchen_arrival.title: Team Kitchen Arrival Stats

total_team_shot_percentage.description: The percentage of total team shots taken by the player.
total_team_shot_percentage.title: Percentage

trends.description: Summary of a player's stats from one game

won_game.description: Whether the player won the game

receiving_side.description: Percent of rallies the player makes it to the kitchen when on the serving side

serving_side.description: Percent of rallies the player makes it to the kitchen when on the receiving side

num_rallies.description: How many rallies were in the game

agility.description: How efficiently and effectively the player moved

consistency.description: How well the player avoids unforced errors

ball_control.description: How well the player controls the ball

kitchen_game.description: Ability in the non-volley zone (kitchen) game

targeting.description: How well the player places their shots

ratings.description: A rating of the player's skill in various categories based on this one game. Which categories are rated depends on the trend version (see RATING_CATEGORIES_BY_VERSION). These ratings can be converted to a DUPR-like scale using the formula `2 + 6 * percentage` (i.e., the percentage [0,1] maps to the range [2,8]).

out.description: Percent of too long, short or wide serves (fault)
Percent of too long, short or wide serves (fault)

serve_speed.description: 17 buckets for % of serves at speeds of <17.5mph (bucket index 0), [17.5-20.0), .., [52.5-55), >=55mph (bucket index 16)

items.description: a percentage expressed as a number between 0 and 1

in.description: Percent of shots that went in

net.description: Percent of shots that were stopped by the net (fault)

out.description: Percent of shots that were out (fault)

average.description: Percent of shots that were quality 0.4 (inclusive) to 0.6 (exclusive)

excellent.description: Percent of shots that were quality 0.8 or higher

fair.description: Percent of shots that were quality 0.2 (inclusive) to 0.4 (exclusive)

good.description: Percent of shots that were quality 0.6 (inclusive) to 0.8 (exclusive)

poor.description: Percent of shots that were quality less than 0.2

shot_selection.description: serves and returns are excluded, as are any shots which don't fall in any of the categories here

dink.description: Percent of shots that were dinks

drive.description: Percent of shots that were drives

drop.description: Percent of shots that were drops

reset.description: Percent of shots that were resets

trends_missing_reasons.description: Reasons explaining why trends data is missing for this player. Present only when `trends` is omitted.

title: Player Data
